'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Mike Richards DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
